note: Approximate raw-score-to-band conversions. Exact values vary slightly between test versions.
overall_rounding: Average the four bands. .25 rounds up to .5, .75 rounds up to the next whole band, anything else rounds down to the nearest half band.
scaling_for_partial_practice: For a single 10- or 13-question set, estimate a /40 score by scaling: raw / questions * 40.
